changelog: - **A visitor stays on the host they are on — the marketing site no longer bounces people to the internship site** (#2488, epic #2348). One container serves several public hosts, but NextAuth resolved every `callbackUrl` against `NEXTAUTH_URL` (the internship host) and never saw the request, so signing out on `marketing.ersah.in` — or being sent back to sign-in after a password change, a sign-out-everywhere or an account deletion — landed on `interncrm.com`; the SSO and Google-Calendar failure redirects and the `/release-notes` feed link were built from the same env value. New `src/lib/servedHosts.ts` (zero imports, unit-tested) derives the set of hosts this deployment serves from config that already exists — the hostname of `NEXTAUTH_URL`/`NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` plus `MARKETING_HOSTS` — with exact-match only: no wildcard, no suffix rule, no new env var (a topic env is covered because its own host is its `NEXTAUTH_URL`). `authOptions.callbacks.redirect` now keeps an absolute `callbackUrl` iff its host is in that set (a relative one still resolves against `baseUrl`, NextAuth-default parity; `interncrm.com.evil.example`, `https://interncrm.com@evil.example`, comma lists, received ports and non-https schemes all fall back to `baseUrl`); `signOutEverywhere` and the SSO completion send an absolute same-origin `callbackUrl` (`absoluteHere` in `safeRedirect.ts`); the SSO login and Google-connect routes and `publicOrigin()` derive their origin from the validated request host (`requestOrigin`), never downgrading the protocol and never trusting a received port. Byte-identical on the internship host. Still on the other host by design and tracked separately: the SAML ACS and the Google OAuth redirect_uri (registered at the IdP/Google) and e-mail links (`NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`).

en: Signing out — or being sent back to sign-in — on the marketing site now keeps you on the marketing site instead of jumping to the internship one.
tr: Pazarlama sitesinde çıkış yapınca — ya da giriş sayfasına yönlendirilince — artık pazarlama sitesinde kalıyorsunuz; staj sitesine atlamıyor.
de: Wer sich auf der Marketing-Seite abmeldet — oder zur Anmeldung zurückgeschickt wird — bleibt jetzt auf der Marketing-Seite statt zur Praktikums-Seite zu springen.
